# Dataset intake and provenance

Public fisheries datasets are valuable for **checking file structures and software interoperability**. They do not automatically validate camera geometry, persistent fish identity, tracking generalization or animal welfare.

## Data and benchmark entry points

| Source / workstream | Why it is useful | Limitation to retain |
|---|---|---|
| Oxford video observations | Independent benchmark workflow and real frame/PTS structure | Source annotations may have model-assisted review |
| Fraunhofer dense-fish aquarium | Tracking pressure, overlapping fish and MOT benchmark contracts | Independent identity reference and source rights must be checked |
| 3D-ZeF multiview records | Real multi-camera structures and labeled tracks | Labels are not independent physical underwater XYZ surveys |
| FishSizing stereo ROS examples | Stereo K/D/R/P calibration structures and length reference formats | Independent real calibrated length benchmark remains required |
| GoPro raw recording with GPMF | Actual MP4 PTS and metadata parsing | Metadata alone does not establish synchronized exposure or lens correctness |

The repository contains read-only data-structure probes and contracts. **Do not redistribute** original datasets or derive universal fish-accuracy claims without permissions and independent benchmarking.

## Recommended intake sequence

1. Record external dataset source, original license and access date.
2. Record each file's SHA-256 and video recording identity.
3. Inspect frame PTS and verify that files were not silently transcoded.
4. Identify which annotations are manually adjudicated versus model-assisted.
5. Separate the training, development and heldout evaluation units.
6. Preserve camera ID, recording ID, tank ID, species label, timestamp and calibration provenance.
7. Verify reference 3D physical measurements and coordinate units independently.
8. Release only source-licensed benchmark outputs and appropriate summaries.

## Relevant software interfaces

[`aqt_provenance_new()`](../reference/aqt_provenance_new.html), [`aqt_provenance_verify()`](../reference/aqt_provenance_verify.html), [`aqt_3dzef_agreement_import()`](../reference/aqt_3dzef_agreement_import.html), [`aqt_video_bundle_benchmark()`](../reference/aqt_video_bundle_benchmark.html) and [`aqt_multiview_holdout_protocol()`](../reference/aqt_multiview_holdout_protocol.html).
